title: Building Smarter for a Hotter Climate

body.en: Some construction choices reduce heat, water use, and emissions; others make buildings less climate-resilient. Sort each choice.

items.label: Using compressed earth blocks instead of standard concrete blocks
Large windows placed for natural cross-ventilation
Painting the roof a reflective light colour
Bare concrete walls with no shading or insulation
Importing materials with high transport emissions when local options exist
